name: Excel Export Button
description: Custom widget button that exports bound SAC data to an Excel (.xlsx) file.

buttonText.description: Label shown on the export button

includeTotals.description: Append a totals row for numeric measure columns

autoExportOnClick.description: When true, clicking the widget button exports immediately. Set false to export only from story script.

exportToExcel.description: Export all currently bound dimensions and measures to Excel.

downloadXLSX.description: Export selected dimensions and measures to Excel.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Column headers in the Excel file

exportJson.description: Export a JSON payload with headers and rows arrays.

parameters.name: jsonText
parameters.description: JSON string: {"headers":[],"rows":[]} or an array of objects

setButtonText.description: Change the button label at runtime.

setFileName.description: Change the download file name at runtime.

setSheetName.description: Change the worksheet name at runtime.

onClick.description: Fired when the export button is clicked.

onExportComplete.description: Fired after the Excel file download is triggered.

onExportError.description: Fired when export fails, for example when no model is bound.
